title: At the Airport
context: You are at the airport checking in for your flight. Practice asking questions and giving information.
opening_line: Good morning! May I see your passport, please?

title: At the Restaurant
context: You are ordering food at a restaurant. Practice polite requests and preferences.
opening_line: Welcome! Are you ready to order?

title: Job Interview
context: You are in a job interview. Talk about your experience and skills.
opening_line: Tell me about your previous work experience.

title: At the Doctor's
context: You are visiting a doctor. Describe your symptoms and medical history.
opening_line: What seems to be the problem today?

title: Shopping
context: You are shopping for clothes. Ask about sizes, prices, and colors.
opening_line: Hello! Can I help you find something?
